scope: Predicate/entity governance for the real-estate vertical only (property status/deadline signals via Laya, 10_API/gmv_property_signals.py + gmv_property_claims.py; fact extraction via NuExtract3, 10_API/gmv_property_extract_templates.py). A separate, domain-neutral + Area35-art ontology registry (GMV_ONTOLOGY_REGISTRY_v0.1.json, same top-level shape) exists but only on the unmerged branch worktree-bridge-cse_01EFSz2nNresRvPh9GbfwwzK -- not depended on here deliberately. If that branch is ever merged, CORE-tier entries here (DOCUMENT) should be reconciled against its CORE tier, not treated as permanently separate.
governance_rule: reuse-before-invention: a new entity class or predicate must be registered here as CANDIDATE, with real evidence and rationale, before use. It cannot silently enter canonical (CORE/DOMAIN) vocabulary. A predicate absent from this file's CANDIDATE/DOMAIN/CORE list must never be emitted by an extraction template -- see fact_extraction_contract below.

status_values.CORE: Domain-neutral, expected to apply across any GMV vertical.
status_values.DOMAIN: Specific to the real-estate vertical. Not expected to generalize without review.
status_values.CANDIDATE: Proposed, evidenced, but not yet governed. May be promoted only by an explicit decision, never silently.
status_values.DEPRECATED: Superseded; retained only so historical references resolve.
status_values.PROPOSED: Named in the user's 2026-09-28 v0.1 vocabulary proposal (see proposed_vocabulary_v0_1 below) but not yet evidenced by any real document. Never usable in an extraction template's predicate enum until promoted to CANDIDATE with a real source_reference, same bar as every other entry here.

note_on_scope_v1: 2026-09-28, first pass: only mentions_deadline (Laya's typed-decision signal, validated 14/14) was registered.
note_on_scope_v2: 2026-09-28, second pass: registered a first small set of NuExtract-evidenced predicates (tributo_*/obbligo_*/rata_* families) from one real TARI notice, cross-checked against the GMV Real Estate Knowledge Pipeline Notion workspace (a separate, already-active ChatGPT-built pipeline for the same six properties -- not duplicated here, its 'Codice immobile' identity scheme was adopted for PROPERTY).
note_on_scope_v3: 2026-09-28, third pass (this version): user proposed a cleaner, more complete v0.1 vocabulary -- uniform `ha_*`/verb-style predicate names (not per-entity-prefixed), a SOGGETTO->PREDICATO->OGGETTO triple as the base shape, and a mandatory rich evidence envelope per fact (see fact_extraction_contract below), critically including `ambito` to stop a shared condominium expense from being misattributed to a single unit -- a real correctness risk the v2 registry did not guard against. The v2 tributo_*/obbligo_*/rata_* predicates are DEPRECATED in favor of the new naming (same real TARI-notice evidence carried over, re-expressed); the full proposed vocabulary (~140 predicates across 14 categories) is recorded verbatim in proposed_vocabulary_v0_1 for traceability, but NOT registered as CANDIDATE wholesale -- same reuse-before-invention discipline as before, now made mechanically enforceable: gmv_property_extract_templates.py's fact-extraction template constrains NuExtract's own `predicato` field to an enum of only the CANDIDATE/DOMAIN/CORE predicate_ids below, so an unevidenced PROPOSED predicate cannot even be emitted, let alone silently governed. A second, explicitly deferred reconciliation-predicate set (movimento_attribuito_a_immobile, obbligo_saldato_da, etc.) is recorded separately below and intentionally excluded from any extraction template -- per the user's own stated rule, these require cross-document matching/rules/review, not single-document extraction, and NuExtract must never be asked to infer them.

mandatory_envelope_fields.soggetto: string -- the fact's subject, verbatim or a short constructed identifier (e.g. a rata's own label)
mandatory_envelope_fields.predicato: string -- MUST be one of this registry's CANDIDATE/DOMAIN/CORE predicate_ids, enforced by the template's own enum, never free text
mandatory_envelope_fields.oggetto: string | number | date -- typed per the matching predicate's range
mandatory_envelope_fields.valuta: string | null -- ISO currency code when oggetto is a monetary amount, else null
mandatory_envelope_fields.ambito: one of: immobile | unita | quota_individuale | intero_condominio | conto_corrente -- MANDATORY distinction so a shared condominium cost is never attributed as if it were owed by/about a single property or unit
mandatory_envelope_fields.fonte: string -- source document identifier (this repo's file_id, sha256:<hex>)
mandatory_envelope_fields.testo_evidenza: string -- the exact source text the fact was read from, never paraphrased
mandatory_envelope_fields.stato_evidenza: one of: esplicito | inferito -- esplicito only when the document states the fact in these words; inferito is not the same as guessed -- an inferito fact must still be traceable to testo_evidenza, not invented

fact_extraction_contract.central_rule: NuExtract extracts only what a document states. A payment plan documents what is owed; a bank instruction documents an order; a proof of execution documents a payment. Reconciling these into 'is this obligation actually paid' is a SEPARATE, deferred step (see deferred_reconciliation_predicates) -- never something a single extraction call should be asked to conclude. An absent field stays null; an unmatched payment stays unverified, never assumed.

entity_classes.definition: A source artifact (contract, verbale, email, report) anchoring provenance. Same concept as gmv_evidence_pipeline.py's file_id (sha256:<hex>).

A real-estate property (a building or unit) as a graph-vocabulary subject for claims. NOT a Core OID type (ADR_DB008_OID_PREFIX_TYPE_CONSISTENCY.md's OID contract is a closed six-prefix map). Identity source is Dropbox 02_IMMOBILI/01_PORTFOLIO/<PROPERTY>/OBJECT.yaml, realigned 2026-09-28 to match the real Notion 'Codice immobile' convention (e.g. gmv_id='GERMIGNAGA').
entity_classes.source_reference: Notion 'Immobili' data sources under each property's Pilota/Scheda page (Codice immobile field, queried live 2026-09-28)

entity_classes.definition: A real-estate legal/commercial agreement document (lease, renewal, insurance policy, sale preliminary).
A person or institution acting as debtor, creditor, landlord, tenant, or other party. Deliberately not split into PERSON vs ORGANIZATION -- not evidenced as a real distinction needed yet.
entity_classes.source_reference: Real TARI notice, 2026-09-28: debtor 'VALERIO GIACOMO MARCO' (a person), creditor 'Comune di Germignaga' (an institution)

predicates.definition: Laya's typed-decision signal (not NuExtract): subject document/property text contains an explicit operative deadline. object_raw is the evidence excerpt itself, not a parsed date -- a coarser, faster, cheaper cousin of ha_scadenza below (see relationship note). Kept as its own predicate: different production mechanism (Laya, ~8ms, always-on triage) than the NuExtract fact predicates in this file (slower, deliberate, per-document extraction).
predicates.relationship_note: Where both run on the same document, ha_scadenza (below) is the more precise, dated fact; mentions_deadline is the fast pre-filter that decides whether it's worth running NuExtract at all.

predicates.definition: The kind of document (e.g. 'avviso TARI', 'accertamento IMU', 'contratto di locazione').
predicates.source_reference: Real TARI notice, 2026-09-28: 'AVVISO DI PAGAMENTO TARI - ANNO 2026'

predicates.definition: Subject document concerns the object property. Supersedes v2's tributo_riguarda_immobile/obbligo_riguarda_immobile (one relation at the document level, not duplicated per fact type).
predicates.source_reference: Real TARI notice: contextual link via the property folder scanned, same convention gmv_property_signals.py relies on -- not yet stated verbatim inside a document's own text in any case tested so far
Real TARI notice: 'AVVISO DI PAGAMENTO TARI - ANNO 2026'; real IMU accertamento, 2026-09-28: 'IMPOSTA MUNICIPALE PROPRIA ANNO 2021'

predicates.definition: The tax year the assessment covers.
predicates.source_reference: Real TARI notice: 'ANNO 2026'; real IMU accertamento: 'ANNO 2021'
Real TARI notice + IMU accertamento: 'Comune di Germignaga ... Area Finanziaria - Servizio Tributi'

predicates.definition: The party who owes the obligation stated in the document.
predicates.source_reference: Real TARI notice: 'Intestatario: VALERIO GIACOMO MARCO C.F./P.IVA: VLRGMM76T03F205C'

predicates.definition: The party owed by the obligation stated in the document.

The total amount owed, a real typed number (not a descriptive string like v2's obbligo_ha_importo -- NuExtract3's `number` type hint verified to return a real JSON float, e.g. 222.0, not text). Currency goes in the envelope's separate `valuta` field, never embedded in the number.

predicates.definition: Which installment number a rata-shaped fact refers to (1, 2, ...).

The due date of an obligation or one of its installments. Supersedes v2's rata_scade_il, now typed as a real date (NuExtract3's `date-time` type hint verified to return a real ISO date string, e.g. '2026-09-15').
The base tax-assessment component of an accertamento, distinct from sanzioni/interessi.
predicates.source_reference: Real IMU accertamento, 2026-09-28: '(a) TOTALE MAGGIOR TRIBUTO (IMPOSTA) 1.276,00' -> 1276.0

predicates.definition: The interest component of an accertamento.

deferred_reconciliation_predicates.note: Explicitly OUT of any extraction template's predicate enum, per the user's own stated rule: these require cross-document matching, rules, and review (matching the real Notion 'Contratto Identity Resolution Immobiliare v1.0' contract's own CONFERMATO_UTENTE/DOCUMENTATO/CONTROLLATO/DA_RIVEDERE evidence tiers) -- NuExtract must never be asked to conclude these from a single document.
